valid_packet_verified.argument: The control-row lock and fresh statement snapshot advance position only across visible contiguous immutable versions. Row insertion and position commit together, so position>=B proves all source versions 1..B are durable. The primary repeatable-read snapshot rechecks readiness and filters event<=B; choosing the largest eligible event per finding therefore yields exactly the required effective states. Later closes cannot hide a blocker at an earlier cutoff. Digest-pinned immutable previews, fetch verification and conditional whole-result publication satisfy the object and failure behavior. No proven independent side violation or new contradiction found.
valid_packet_verified.limits: This is documentary contract/model correctness, not a claim that an unprovided production implementation was tested. Unspecified SLOs, privacy, capacity and disaster recovery remain questions, not proven defects.
